params.q: How many weeks of paid maternity leave are women entitled to in India?

search_parameters.q: How many weeks of paid maternity leave are women entitled to in India?

response.markdown:
Women in India are entitled to **26 weeks of fully paid maternity leave** for their first two children under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 (as amended in 2017). [0] [1] [2] The entitlement drops to **12 weeks** for a third or subsequent child, and for adoptive or commissioning (surrogate) mothers. [3] [4] [1] [5] [6] [7] Up to 8 weeks of the 26-week leave may be taken before the expected delivery date. [8] [6] [4] [2] [0] [9] [1] [5]

| Situation | Paid leave |
|---|---|
| First or second child | 26 weeks |
| Third child onward | 12 weeks |
| Adoption (child under 3 months) | 12 weeks |
| Commissioning mother (surrogacy) | 12 weeks |
| Miscarriage / medical termination | 6 weeks |

To be eligible, a woman must have worked at least 80 days in the 12 months preceding her expected delivery, and the law applies to establishments with 10 or more employees. [1] [4] [8] [0]
